<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/prospects"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Query and paginate through prospects with optional filtering by list IDs, priorities,
enrichment statuses, and fuzzy search on name, organization, or title.

**Pagination:** Uses cursor-based pagination with document IDs as tokens.

**Filtering:** All filters are applied in-memory after Firestore query.
